6.315 rsNestedLookups
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsNestedLookups is a critical error that will occur when a Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup function
is specified as the argument to another Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup function.
